PX-200 Sensor

The PX-200 measures pressure from 0 to 200 kPa with an accuracy of 0.1 %. It runs on 3.3 V and draws 2 mA in continuous mode.

Ordering

Order the sensor from the PX-200 product page, or read the manual at https://docs.example/px-200/manual.

Safety

Do not exceed 250 kPa. Calibrate the sensor every twelve months.
